verdict.rationale: Wave documents standard reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons, but nothing shows custom report building filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag. The homepage slogan "Tag it, track it" is too vague to count as dimensional reporting, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
